clue.text: Emperor, touring state finally, greets English girl

indicators.note: the greeting word goes on a tour round the letter picked from state, enclosing it

parts.note: to greet someone is to hail them

indicators.note: finally points to the closing letter of the word state

parts.note: lassie is a Scottish word for a girl

explanation.surface: A ruler on a state visit, at the end of the tour, says hello to an English girl.
explanation.walkthrough: 'touring' puts E (the last letter of 'state') inside HAILS.
explanation.definitionFit: Haile Selassie was the last emperor of Ethiopia, reigning until 1974.

clue.text: One demanding careful negotiation needs lock-keeper to be flexible

parts.note: a hairpin keeps locks of hair in place
to bend is to be flexible

explanation.surface: A canal lock-keeper must be adaptable to manage a tricky deal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lock-keeper' suggests a canal, but the locks are locks of hair.
explanation.definitionFit: A very sharp turn in a road must be driven round with great care, so it demands careful negotiation.

clue.text: Contribution made by computing where successors to MOT involved

indicators.note: involved means wrapped up within, so one piece sits inside the other

parts.note: IT, information technology, stands for computing
the letters that come straight after M, O and T in the alphabet are N, P and U

explanation.surface: A remark about which newer tests replaced the MOT vehicle check in computing.
explanation.walkthrough: The MOT is Britain's annual roadworthiness test for cars, but here M, O, T are just three letters whose alphabet successors are wanted.
explanation.definitionFit: Input is a contribution made to a discussion or project, as in giving one's input.

clue.text: Space to move barge and tie up

parts.note: to barge through a crowd is to elbow your way

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word for tie is read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: to moor a boat is to tie it up

explanation.surface: Tying up a canal barge needs some room to manoeuvre.
explanation.walkthrough: 'barge' looks like a boat to be tied up, but it is the verb 'to push'; 'up' reverses MOOR to ROOM.
explanation.definitionFit: Elbow room is enough free space to move about comfortably.

clue.text: Customer from America coming in closer

indicators.note: coming in means the short country abbreviation enters the word for closer

parts.note: an ender is something that closes or finishes
US is short for the United States of America

explanation.surface: A shopper from the States moves nearer.
explanation.definitionFit: An end user is the final consumer of a product, the customer who actually uses it.

clue.text: Aye, it's awful having no one to date!

indicators.note: awful suggests something badly mangled, so the letters are rearranged
having no means a letter is taken away

parts.note: the contraction gives the letters I, T, S
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A lament: yes, it is terrible having nobody to go out with.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to date' looks like romance, but it means 'so far'. Remove I from ITS and rearrange AYE + TS.
explanation.definitionFit: As yet means up to now, which is what to date means.

clue.text: One set off to obscure joint with lots of money

parts.note: a joint is a cannabis cigarette, a smoke
a bomb is British slang for a large sum of money, as in costing a bomb

explanation.surface: Something used to hide a drug deal involving a cannabis cigarette and a fortune.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Costs a bomb' is British slang for 'is very expensive'.
explanation.definitionFit: A smoke bomb is a device set off to give out a cloud that hides things from view.

clue.text: Survivor escaping clutches of Catholic priest

indicators.note: the outer letters held as if in a grip get away, leaving the inside

parts.note: a relic is something surviving from the past
RC stands for Roman Catholic

explanation.surface: Someone who survived breaks free from a Catholic priest's grasp.
explanation.walkthrough: R and C are the two ends of RELIC, so removing them leaves the middle.
explanation.definitionFit: Eli is the priest of Shiloh in the Old Testament who raised Samuel.

clue.text: Net supplier on western strand

indicators.note: on means the Net supplier is placed after the western letter

parts.note: an ISP, internet service provider, supplies the Net

explanation.surface: A fishing-net maker working on a western shore.
explanation.walkthrough: 'strand' suggests a beach, but the definition is a thin thread, as of hair or smoke.
explanation.definitionFit: A wisp is a thin strand, such as a wisp of hair.

clue.text: Shoot video: my original film about Brotherhood

parts.note: a bud is a new shoot on a plant

indicators.note: original here means novel or freshly made, so the letters are reworked

explanation.surface: A director's instruction to record an innovative film about brotherhood.
explanation.walkthrough: 'original' asks for VIDEO MY to be rearranged into DYMOVIE.
explanation.definitionFit: A buddy movie is a film genre centred on the friendship of two companions.

clue.text: In spring resorts to interfering in causes

indicators.note: interfering in means getting inside, so one word is placed within another

parts.note: to spawn something is to cause it, give rise to it

explanation.surface: In spring, people turn to meddling in campaigns.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spring' looks like the season, but it is a mineral spring, and 'In' at the front is just a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Spa towns are resorts grown up around mineral springs, like Bath or Harrogate.

clue.text: It follows you around state of eastern US

indicators.note: around means the word for you goes round the state abbreviation

parts.note: thee is the old form of you
NC is the abbreviation for North Carolina, on the US east coast

explanation.surface: A stalker follows you across an eastern American state.
explanation.walkthrough: 'It follows' looks like a pursuer, but means 'from that it follows'.
explanation.definitionFit: Thence means from there, therefore, introducing a consequence that follows.

clue.text: Girl held in check with large foam stick at station? Hardly!

indicators.note: held in means the girl's name sits inside the other letters

parts.note: CH is the chess abbreviation for check
L is the clothing-size abbreviation for large
Anne is a girl's name
surf is the foam of breaking waves

explanation.surface: A girl kept in line with a big foam stick at a railway station.
explanation.walkthrough: 'station' is a TV station: someone who channel-surfs hardly sticks with one.
explanation.definitionFit: To channel-surf is to flick restlessly between TV channels, the opposite of staying on one station.

clue.text: Off I run, cunningly overtaking a very old pro

indicators.note: overtaking means getting round something, so the rearranged letters surround the short group
cunningly suggests craft and trickery, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A runner sets off and craftily passes an elderly professional athlete.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cunningly' signals the rearrangement and 'overtaking' the wrap round A, V, O. 'pro' is not a professional but a preposition meaning 'for'.
explanation.definitionFit: Pro as a preposition means for or supporting, the same as in favour of.

clue.text: Artist is overwhelmed by shock judgement

indicators.note: overwhelmed by means swallowed up, so the shorter pieces go inside

parts.note: to appal is to shock
RA is a Royal Academician, a recognised artist

explanation.surface: A painter is stunned by a shocking verdict on the work.
explanation.definitionFit: An appraisal is an assessment or evaluation, a considered judgement.

clue.text: Meditation following a breather on Grampians summit

parts.note: F is the abbreviation for following, as in page references
a lung is what breathes
taken as written

indicators.note: summit means the top, the first letter in a down clue

explanation.surface: Meditating after catching one's breath on top of a Scottish mountain range.
explanation.walkthrough: The Grampians are mountains in Scotland.
explanation.definitionFit: Falun Gong is a Chinese spiritual practice built on meditation and qigong exercises.

clue.text: Hearts in love, sealed in the form of Easter gift

definitions.text: in the form of Easter gift

indicators.note: the hearts of words are their central letters

explanation.surface: Romantic hearts sealed in love, shaped like an Easter present.
explanation.walkthrough: The centres are OV from 'love' and AL from 'sealed'.
explanation.definitionFit: Easter gifts are eggs, and oval means egg-shaped.

clue.text: Vehicle bringing drug twice impounded by magistrate

indicators.note: impounded by means locked up inside, so the drug letters go within

parts.note: JP is a justice of the peace, a magistrate

indicators.note: twice means the letter for the drug is used two times

parts.note: E is short for ecstasy

explanation.surface: A car seized by a magistrate because it carried drugs on two occasions.
explanation.definitionFit: A jeep is a rugged off-road motor vehicle.

clue.text: Chemist back on track in West London area

indicators.note: in means the other pieces are placed inside the film star's name

parts.note: Mae West was the Hollywood actress

indicators.note: on means the reversed chemist comes after the railway letters

parts.note: RY is short for railway, a track

indicators.note: back means the chemist's name is read backwards

parts.note: Alfred Nobel was the Swedish chemist who invented dynamite

explanation.surface: A pharmacist returns to his rail route in a district of west London.
explanation.walkthrough: 'West London' runs together, but West is Mae West, holding RY plus LEBON (NOBEL backwards).
explanation.definitionFit: Marylebone is a district of central London, home of Baker Street and Lord's.

clue.text: Rude sort: one to scoff

indicators.note: rude in the sense of rough or crude, so the letters are knocked about

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A coarse person, the kind to sneer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'scoff' looks like 'mock', but it is British slang for food. 'Rude' rearranges SORT plus I into RISOT.
explanation.definitionFit: Scoff is informal for food, and a risotto is an Italian rice dish.

clue.text: Lear's close to rage with daughters, torn by conflict

definitions.note: the definition stands for Lear's first name, the possessive saying whose name it is

indicators.note: close to means the final letter of rage
torn by means split apart by, so the daughters' letters are separated by the conflict

parts.note: D is short for daughter, so two daughters give DD
war is armed conflict

explanation.surface: King Lear near to fury, his daughters torn apart by strife.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lear' suggests Shakespeare's king with his daughters, but it is the poet Edward Lear.
explanation.definitionFit: Edward was the forename of Lear, the Victorian nonsense poet.

clue.text: Import to move around without end

definitions.meaning: import here is meaning or gist
to wander aimlessly, endlessly carried about

explanation.definitionFit: Drift is both the gist of what is said and aimless wandering movement.

clue.text: Indian statesman will exchange capital for bank on the Strand

indicators.note: exchange capital means the opening letter is swapped for a different one

parts.note: Mahatma Gandhi led India to independence
will is shortened to 'll, as in he'll

explanation.surface: An Indian leader will trade in a capital city for a riverside bank.
explanation.walkthrough: The capital G is swapped for S; the clue does not say where S comes from, a weakness the blog noted. The Strand is a London street, but here it means a beach.
explanation.definitionFit: A sandhill is a dune, a bank of sand by the shore.

clue.text: Composer making case for weapon to eliminate monarch

indicators.note: to eliminate means letters are removed from the gun case

parts.note: a holster is a case for a pistol
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the monarch

explanation.surface: A musician argues that guns should be used to get rid of the king.
explanation.definitionFit: Gustav Holst was the English composer of The Planets.

clue.text: Ham players paid to start filming instead, entertaining one

parts.note: pros, professionals, are players who are paid

indicators.note: entertaining means hosting, so the numeral goes inside

parts.note: cut to is the script direction to switch to filming another shot
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Overacting performers are paid to begin shooting a new scene with a single extra.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ham' looks like a bad actor among players, but it is the cured meat.
explanation.definitionFit: Prosciutto is Italian dry-cured ham.

clue.text: One of the ranks falling out

definitions.meaning: a line of seats or people, one rank among many

explanation.definitionFit: A row is both a line of things side by side and a noisy quarrel.

clue.text: Seconds from flatlining, now business, oddly, booming

indicators.note: seconds from means the second letter of each of the following words

explanation.surface: Seconds after a heart flatlines, the strangely thriving business.
explanation.walkthrough: The second letters of flatlining, now, business and oddly are L, O, U, D.
explanation.definitionFit: A booming voice or noise is a loud one.

clue.text: Respected a lot less from Camberwell, though, to Finchley!

indicators.note: a lot less means most of the phrase is dropped, leaving the run of letters inside

explanation.surface: An exclamation about the long trip across London from Camberwell to Finchley.
explanation.walkthrough: Camberwell and Finchley are districts of London, south and north.
explanation.definitionFit: Well-thought-of means highly regarded, respected.
